# llms.txt

## Repository Summary
- Workshop: The Architecture of Intent
- Session Type: Professional Prompting and Human Communication
- Total Duration: 120 minutes
- Core Method: C.L.E.A.R.+ with Diagnose-Isolate-Constrain iteration
- Primary Objective: produce reliable, auditable AI delegation prompts through collaborative practice

## Workshop Architecture (120-Minute Sequence)
1. 00:00-00:15 | Welcome, Contract, Baseline Diagnostic
2. 00:15-00:35 | The Human Delegation Lab
3. 00:35-00:50 | Assumption Gap + C.L.E.A.R.+ Engine
4. 00:50-01:00 | Break / Rest and Informal Table Chat
5. 01:00-01:25 | Prompt Makeover Studio (Triad Refactoring)
6. 01:25-01:50 | Live Iteration Crucible (Solo + Peer Audit)
7. 01:50-02:00 | Synthesis, Commitment Contract, Final Evaluation

## C.L.E.A.R.+ Protocol
- C: Context and Goal (problem, business setting, completion condition)
- L: Limits and Negative Constraints (boundaries, exclusions, non-negotiables)
- E: Expected Output (format, sections, length, output quality bar)
- A: Audience (reader profile, tone, domain depth)
- R: Role and Process (model persona and reasoning process)
- +: Iteration and Verification (revision loop, pass-fail checks)

## Iteration Loop
1. Diagnose: identify failed C.L.E.A.R.+ field
2. Isolate: change one variable only
3. Constrain: add explicit exclusions and verification rules

## Presenter Overlay Architecture
- index.html contains exactly one global `#speaker-overlay` element outside the slide container.
- Per-slide notes exist only in `data-speaker-time`, `data-speaker-say`, `data-speaker-do` attributes on `<section>` elements.
- JavaScript injects active slide metadata into `#speaker-time`, `#speaker-say`, `#speaker-do` on slide change and when overlay opens.
- Overlay default state is hidden (`aria-hidden="true"`, no `open` class).
- Hotkeys: `s` toggles overlay (case-insensitive), `Escape` closes overlay.

## Repository Index
- [index.html](index.html): Reveal.js deck, singleton presenter overlay, synchronized speaker metadata
- [cheatsheet.html](cheatsheet.html): participant quick reference, timing guardrails, and prompt skeletons
- [script.md](script.md): full facilitator runbook with verbatim lines and operations cues
- [README.md](README.md): repository overview and 120-minute delivery guide
- [docs/workshop-summary.md](docs/workshop-summary.md): compressed workshop operations summary
- [docs/prompting-framework.md](docs/prompting-framework.md): protocol details and templates
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): autonomous execution and git lifecycle directives

## Validation Gates
- Pacing consistency: all assets align to 120-minute sequence and break interval.
- Overlay integrity: singleton `#speaker-overlay` and no slide-embedded duplicates.
- Notes completeness: each slide has time/say/do metadata.
- Interaction safety: `s` toggle ignores typing contexts and supports case-insensitive key handling.
- Path integrity: all repository index links resolve.
